span.term: experience replay: store past transitions and train on random minibatches of them, breaking the correlations between consecutive experiences and stabilizing deep Q-learning
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: reinforcement learning presents several challenges from a deep-learning perspective
span.note: what this limits: the transfer of supervised deep learning intuitions to this setting: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING PRESENTS SEVERAL CHALLENGES FROM A DEEP LEARNING PERSPECTIVE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The replay memory is uniformly sampled and finite, so it neither prioritises informative transitions nor retains old ones.
span.note: what this limits: the sample efficiency and stability results: THE MEMORY BUFFER DOES NOT DIFFERENTIATE IMPORTANT TRANSITIONS AND ALWAYS OVERWRITES WITH RECENT TRANSITIONS DUE TO THE FINITE MEMORY SIZE N
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Clipping all rewards to +1/-1 removes the agent's ability to distinguish rewards of different magnitude.
span.note: what this limits: any task where reward magnitude matters: reward clipping means the agent CANNOT DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN REWARDS OF DIFFERENT MAGNITUDE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Performance remains far below human level on games needing strategies over long time scales.
span.note: what this limits: the human-comparison headline: THE GAMES Q*BERT, SEAQUEST, SPACE INVADERS, ON WHICH WE ARE FAR FROM HUMAN PERFORMANCE, ARE MORE CHALLENGING BECAUSE THEY REQUIRE ... A STRATEGY THAT EXTENDS OVER LONG TIME SCALES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The claim that one setting spans all the games is enabled by the reward change, in the sentence that follows it.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that the same architecture and hyperparameters work across all seven games: the reward clipping is stated to limit the scale of the error derivatives and to make it easier to use the same learning rate across multiple games
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The reward the agent learns from is not the reward it is scored on.
span.note: what this limits: the scores reported for these agents: the agents were evaluated on the real and unmodified games while the reward structure was changed during training only
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The agent cannot see enough of the game to know what state it is in, and the paper says so.
span.note: what this limits: any description of this agent as learning from the game state: the task is partially observed, many emulator states are perceptually aliased, and the paper states it is impossible to fully understand the situation from the current screen alone
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The primary evaluation metric is too noisy to display the result, so a second one is introduced.
span.note: what this limits: the learning curves shown here: the averaged reward plots are described as quite noisy and as giving the impression that the algorithm is not making steady progress, which is why a more stable metric is also reported
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a convolutional network taking raw pixels as input, used as the function approximator for the action-value function in reinforcement learning
